mechanism_narrative: The four-week recovery in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES reflects restored commuting and out-of-home routines that spill over into retail footfall, so RETAIL_REC will be higher over the next four weeks than over the last four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT rose from -29.3 to -2.1 and WORKPLACES from -28.9 to -11.1 across t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is less than or equal to -24.35 while TRANSIT and WORKPLACES continue to rise or stay elevated; then the spillover mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Once GROCERY_PHARM mobility holds above +10 percent for two consecutive weeks, households have normalized routine shopping and no longer divert trips to stockpiling, which increases discretionary retail visits and lifts RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM exceeds +10 percent for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM rose from -4.1 to +19.0 across t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM stays above +10 for two weeks but next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean does not exceed the last-28-day mean, the normalization mechanism fails.

mechanism_narrative: The joint pattern of rising PARKS mobility and falling RESIDENTIAL mobility indicates a shift from staying home to local outings; this interaction increases nearby retail-and-recreation trips, so RETAIL_REC will rise over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS rose from -37.9 to -15.3 and RESIDENTIAL fell from 13.0 to 5.4 across t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next 28 days while PARKS continues to rise and RESIDENTIAL continues to fall, the outing-substitution interaction is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: In a policy-relaxation regime where TRANSIT recovers above -10 percent, reduced travel friction raises retail trips; RETAIL_REC will be higher over the next week than the last week.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from -29.3 to -2.1 across t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is lower than or equal to the last 7-day mean when TRANSIT is above -10 percent.

mechanism_narrative: Seasonal warming raises PARKS mobility and pulls leisure trips outdoors, diverting spending from indoor retail-and-recreation venues; RETAIL_REC will decline over the next two weeks relative to the last two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS improved from -37.9 to -15.3 across t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days while PARKS continues to recover toward baseline, the outdoor-diversion seasonal mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Joint recovery in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT under relaxed restrictions increases weekday commercial activity; this interaction raises RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises above -5 percent and WORKPLACES rises above -10 percent
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES rose to -11.1 and TRANSIT to -2.1 at t-0w
regime_hint: policy relaxation with office and transit reopening
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than the last 28-day mean while TRANSIT is above -5 and WORKPLACES above -10, the policy-interaction hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: Retail recovery momentum is self-reinforcing: once RETAIL_REC rises above -15 percent for one week, reduced virus fear and observed crowding attract more visits, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next week.
candidate_trigger: RETAIL_REC exceeds -15 percent for one week
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved from -37.3 to -13.4 across t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is not higher than the last 7-day mean after RETAIL_REC exceeds -15 percent.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM mobility exceeds +15 percent and WORKPLACES recovery exceeds -15 percent, routine errands and commuting trips combine to increase retail-and-recreation visits, so RETAIL_REC will rise over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM exceeds +15 percent and WORKPLACES exceeds -15 percent
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM is +19.0 and WORKPLACES is -11.1 at t-0w
regime_hint: consumer normalization with partial return to workplaces
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not exceed the last 28-day mean when GROCERY_PHARM is above +15 and WORKPLACES above -15, the errand-commute interaction is rejected.
